description: Correct a draft voucher (status 50, Entwurf): date, document number, supplier name, tax rule and the positions (amounts, tax rate, booking account). positions replaces all positions: give the full new list; existing positions are reused in order (they keep their booking account unless accountDatevId is given), extra old ones are deleted. Example: gross 214.20 booked at 0 % -> positions [{sumNet: 180, taxRate: 19}] gives 180.00 + 34.20 VAT = 214.20. Positions you do not replace are sent back as they were entered, net or gross. A new taxRuleId is checked against the voucher's side (expense or revenue) and its position rates. finalize=true also sets the voucher to open (100), needed before sevdesk_link_transaction; every position then needs a booking account. finalize is refused unless the server runs with SEVDESK_ALLOW_BOOKING=true; without it the draft can still be corrected. Refuses open, paid and enshrined vouchers; keeps the attached file; verifies sums and status afterwards. ⚠️ This tool can change data in sevDesk.

dryRun.description: Show the request without sending it.

finalize.description: Also set the voucher from draft (50) to open (100). Refused unless the server runs with SEVDESK_ALLOW_BOOKING=true.

positions.description: The complete new list of positions.

accountDatevId.description: Booking account (AccountDatev) id; default: keep the old one (see sevdesk_receipt_guidance).

comment.description: Text of the position (default: keep the old one).

sumGross.description: Gross amount. Give sumNet or sumGross, the same for all positions.

sumNet.description: Net amount. Give sumNet or sumGross, the same for all positions.

taxRate.description: VAT rate in percent, e.g. 19, 7 or 0.

taxRuleId.description: New tax rule id, e.g. 9 (Vorsteuerabziehbare Aufwendungen).

voucherDate.description: New voucher date, yyyy-mm-dd or dd.mm.yyyy.

name: sevdesk_update_draft_voucher
title: Correct a draft voucher
